title: MedExAgent: Training LLM Agents to Ask, Examine, and Diagnose in Noisy Clinical Environments
abstract: arXiv:2605.07058v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Real-world clinical diagnosis is a complex process in which the doctor is required to obtain information from both interaction with the patient and conducting medical exams. Additionally, the doctor needs to adapt to different patient personas, as well as noisy and incomplete information that can happen at any time during the process. However, existing benchmarks for medical LLMs and methods for automatic diagnosis largely simplify this process by reducing it to single-turn question answering, noise-free conversations, or sequential exam making, etc., ignoring the interactive and uncertain nature of clinical diagnosis. translated_title: MedExAgent：在嘈杂临床环境中训练大语言模型智能体进行询问、检查与诊断
translated_abstract: 真实世界的临床诊断是一个复杂的过程，医生既需要通过与患者的互动获取信息，也需要通过开展医学检查来获取信息。此外，医生还需要适应不同的患者角色设定，以及在整个诊疗过程中随时可能出现的噪声和不完整信息。然而，现有的医学大语言模型基准测试和自动诊断方法在很大程度上简化了这一过程，将其归结为单轮问答、无噪声对话或顺序化的检查安排等，忽略了临床诊断的交互性和不确定性本质。在本文中，我们旨在通过将临床诊断形式化为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）来弥补这一空白，其中包含三种动作类型：向患者提问、以工具调用的形式开具医学检查，以及给出诊断结论。我们还引入了一个系统性的噪声模型，涵盖七种患者……（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出MedExAgent，首次将临床诊断形式化为包含向患者提问、开具医学检查和给出诊断三类动作的POMDP，以训练能够在真实嘈杂临床环境中应对患者多样性与不完整信息的LLM智能体。
en_tdlr: MedExAgent formalizes clinical diagnosis as a POMDP with three action types—questioning the patient, ordering medical exams as tool calls, and issuing a diagnosis—to train LLM agents capable of handling diverse patient personas and noisy, incomplete information in realistic clinical environments.
